meta.title: Five Steps to a Cold Noodle Meal

paragraphs: On Saturday morning, the Explorers went to a cooking class with Teacher Kim. Chef Lucy waited for them in a bright kitchen. "Welcome," she said. "Today you will make a cold noodle meal." "It is simple, and it has five steps." "Please wash your hands first." Lily, Mia, Leo, and May washed their hands and stood at the table.

"Step one," said Chef Lucy. "I will boil the noodles for five minutes, because the water is very hot." "Step two: slice the cucumber into thin pieces." Chef Lucy gave each child a plastic knife. "It is impossible to slice with this knife!" said Leo. "It is not impossible," said Chef Lucy. "Hold the cucumber with your fingers, and push the knife slowly." Mia sliced her cucumber, and the pieces were thin and round.

"Step three: make the sauce," said Chef Lucy. "Put three spoons of soy sauce in a bowl." "Add one spoon of sugar and one spoon of lime juice." "How much chili do we need?" asked May. "Only a little," said Chef Lucy. "If you add too much chili, the meal will be too hot." Leo put in a big spoon of chili, and May looked at his bowl. "Leo, that is too much!" she said. "I like chili!" said Leo.

"Step four: mix the noodles, the cucumber, and the sauce," said Chef Lucy. "Be careful, and use two spoons." "Step five: put the meal on a plate and smile." The children laughed and mixed their bowls. Lily wrote the five steps in her notebook for the blog. "Do you teach this class every week?" she asked. "No," said Chef Lucy, "only once each term, for the school."

Everybody sat at the long table with a plate of cold noodles. Mia's noodles were fresh, and May's meal was perfect. Leo took a big bite of his noodles. His face turned red, and he drank a full glass of water. "I will use only a little chili next time," he said. Chef Lucy smiled and gave him a second glass of water. Teacher Kim took a photo of the happy cooks.
